rendering: Native WebGL using the existing locally vendored three.js 0.186.1
original_scene_content: Lighting, materials, camera, pointer and keyboard controls
Procedural brain, liver, heart and lung forms
Three-dimensional blood and lymph pathway curves
Stage-dependent emphasis and conceptual transport particles
scene_landmark_adjustment: The liver lobes are placed inside the final torso surface: main lobe centre [-0.040, 1.115, 0.015], radii [0.065, 0.040, 0.040]; secondary lobe centre [0.025, 1.125, 0.015], radii [0.045, 0.025, 0.028]. These are illustrative scene coordinates; the mesh metadata landmarks remain the original coarse guides.
scientific_scope: The body and organ shapes are original illustrative geometry, not patient imaging or calibrated anatomy. Pathway locations and particle motion communicate the existing six-stage delivery logic. They do not encode measured anatomy, dose, concentration, velocity or elapsed biological time. No scientific model was rerun and no saved result values were changed.
reuse: Serve the component and its local assets through HTTP. The controller resolves the module and mesh URLs from the component attributes; the scene imports the local three.js module and uses no CDN or external runtime resources.
